fastapi: FastAPI: the package the app and router constructors are imported from, and this pack's name
include_router: FastAPI: the method that mounts a router onto the app
prefix: FastAPI: the path-prefix keyword on APIRouter(...) and include_router(...)
response_model: FastAPI: route-decorator keyword naming the declared response body model
status_code: FastAPI: route-decorator keyword naming the declared response status
Depends: FastAPI: the callable that declares a parameter the framework resolves and passes in, rather than reads off the request
Security: FastAPI: Depends with scopes, declared the same way and injected the same way
Header: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a header, converting the parameter's underscores to hyphens
Query: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a query parameter
Path: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a path parameter
Body: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a field of the JSON body
Form: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a field of a form body
Cookie: FastAPI: the parameter function that reads a cookie
alias: language: Python's grammar calls the name after `as` in an import the alias. FastAPI: the keyword on a parameter function that gives the name the request uses
headers: suss: the parameter role for a header, which the request spelling maps to the headers section
queryParams: suss: the parameter role for a query parameter
pathParams: suss: the parameter role for a path parameter
requestBody: suss: the parameter role for the request body
cookies: suss: the parameter role for a cookie
decoratedFunctionRoute: suss: PythonDiscoveryPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python
braces: suss: path-template syntax name, defined in @suss/adapter-python; selects the {name} reader for FastAPI's Starlette-style paths
router: FastAPI: the include_router parameter that takes the router
FastAPI: FastAPI: the app constructor, whose dependencies, middleware and exception handlers reach every route
dependencies: FastAPI: the keyword on FastAPI(...), APIRouter(...) and a route decorator that lists dependencies run before the handler
middleware: FastAPI: the app decorator that registers a function run around every request
exception_handler: FastAPI: the app decorator that registers a function run when a handler raises
dependency: suss: PyWrapperForm variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a function written in a Depends-style parameter default or dependency list
decoratedWrapper: suss: PyWrapperForm variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a function registered through a decorator attribute on the app
everyRoute: suss: PyWrapperRegistrar coverage, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a registration on the app reaches every route of the pack
ownRoutes: suss: PyWrapperRegistrar coverage, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a registration on a router reaches the routes decorated on that router
